patches.name: Enable Picture-in-Picture
patches.description: Enables Picture-in-Picture support for the ViuTV player activity (adds supportsPictureInPicture and resizeableActivity, and adds screenLayout and smallestScreenSize to configChanges).

patches.name: Force Picture-in-Picture on leave
patches.description: Forces the video player to enter Picture-in-Picture when leaving the app by enabling enterPictureInPictureOnLeave on every created player view (the app's JavaScript never sets this prop).
